How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 90 questions in 90 minutes, at its real passing score of 83%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the Security+ SY0-701 exam?

Up to 90 questions in 90 minutes, multiple choice and performance-based. The passing score is 750 on a scale of 100 to 900.

What are the SY0-701 domains?

General security concepts, threats, vulnerabilities and mitigations, security architecture, security operations, and security program management and oversight.

How much does Security+ cost?

See CompTIA's current voucher price; the course is free.

How does the course decide I am ready?

Three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one ninety-question test at the real passing score of 750 of 900.

Is Security+ harder than Network+?

Most candidates find it broader rather than harder: more terminology, fewer calculations. The cheat sheet carries every term the objectives name.

What is on the CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 exam?

General Security Concepts (12%), Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations (22%), Security Architecture (18%), Security Operations (28%), Security Program Management and Oversight (20%). The course's units follow the same domains, and the practice tests draw on the same domain weights.
